instruction: Look at guih01_fixture_plate_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. For the steps below, launch LibreCAD from `/usr/bin/librecad` before opening `guih01_fixture_plate_seed.dxf`. Create a hard rounded fixture datum plate using exact model-space millimeter coordinates. Layers: OUTLINE, CUT, HOLE, CENTER, DIM. Required OUTLINE straight segments: (20,0)-(220,0), (240,20)-(240,130), (220,150)-(20,150), (0,130)-(0,20). Required OUTLINE arcs: center (20,20) radius 20 start 180 end 270; center (220,20) radius 20 start 270 end 0; center (220,130) radius 20 start 0 end 90; center (20,130) radius 20 start 90 end 180. Required CUT slots: obround 56 x 14 at centers (70,45) and (170,105), plus CUT circle center (120,75) radius 18. Required HOLE circles: centers (35,35), (205,35), (35,115), (205,115) radius 4 and center (120,75) radius 10. Add CENTER axes (0,75)-(240,75) and (120,0)-(120,150). Add DIM text notes 2X SLOT 56X14, 4X Ø8, and DATUM A. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih01_fixture_plate_completed.dxf.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(10); pyautogui.press("enter")
